# Cologne Digital Sanskrit Lexicon (CDSL)

> The open, canonical corpus of Sanskrit dictionaries — Monier-Williams, the Petersburg
> Wörterbücher, the classical kośas and more — digitised, corrected, and published as
> citable, reproducible open data. Cite the whole corpus: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21319331.

## Sites

- [Search the dictionaries](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/): the full-text search over all 30+ dictionaries
- [csl-guides](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/csl-guides/): practical guides to the CDSL data, exports and APIs
- [csl-atlas](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/csl-atlas/): evidence-graded atlas of the Cologne Digital Sanskrit Lexicon
- [csl-observatory](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/csl-observatory/): thirteen years of the CDSL measured as a maintenance ecosystem
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon): source, data and issue trackers

## Dictionaries (Zenodo concept DOIs — each resolves to the latest version)

- [MW — Monier-Williams Sanskrit–English Dictionary (Sir Monier Monier-Williams · Oxford, 1899)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/MWS/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21429504
- [MW72 — Monier-Williams Sanskrit–English Dictionary (1872) (Sir Monier Monier-Williams · Oxford, 1872)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/MW72/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151367
- [AP — The Practical Sanskrit–English Dictionary (Revised & Enlarged) (Vaman Shivram Apte · Poona, 1957)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/AP/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151276
- [AP90 — The Practical Sanskrit–English Dictionary (1890) (Vaman Shivram Apte · Poona, 1890)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/AP90/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151282
- [WIL — A Dictionary in Sanscrit and English (Horace Hayman Wilson · Calcutta, 1832)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/WIL/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22170459
- [BEN — A Sanskrit–English Dictionary (Theodor Benfey · London, 1866)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/BEN/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151226
- [MD — A Practical Sanskrit Dictionary (Arthur Anthony Macdonell · Oxford, 1893)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/MD/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151363

- [AMAR — Amarakośa (Nāmaliṅgānuśāsana) (Amarasiṃha · c. 4th–6th c. CE)](https://sanskrit-lexicon.github.io/AMAR/): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151274

## Corpus citation

- [All dictionaries, one citable release series (csl-sqlite)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21319331): umbrella concept DOI for the whole corpus
